senses.sense_definition: Simple past and past participle of <w>park</w>.

examples.text: She <w>parked</w> her car in the garage before entering the house.

target_lang_translations.ru: Они <w>припарковались</w> незаконно и могут получить штраф.

senses.sense_definition: Left somewhere when not in use, typically referring to a vehicle.

examples.text: There was a long line of <w>parked</w> cars along the street.

target_lang_translations.zh: 街道两旁停着一长排<w>停放的</w>车辆。
